svg.title: The loop's return, hour by hour
svg.desc: Hourly, 2026-09-19 11:00 to 2026-09-24 11:00 UTC, from the reference InfluxDB store (RB5009UG+S+, RouterOS 7.24.4, Linux 5.6.3). Until 2026-09-20 21:00 the kernel logged at most 12 own-address records an hour, while the bridge sent sfp-sfpplus1 nothing in any hour and received 6.5 a second from it. From then until the last record, at 2026-09-23 12:06:46, it logged a median of 1 798 an hour, one every 2.0 s, and the bridge sent ether2 0.6 packets a second against 13 received. Afterwards ether2 received 183 and was sent 144. Rates are medians of the hourly means.
